### Your role

As a Backend Developer at AICines, you'll build and scale the services powering AICines' AI video pipeline — APIs, data, and the infrastructure creators and viewers depend on.

### Day to day, you'll:

Design and build APIs that power the streaming platform and creator tools

Scale backend services to handle real production traffic

Work on the data layer underneath AICines' AI video pipeline

Fix real bugs and handle real scale problems as the platform grows

Collaborate directly with founders and senior engineers on production systems

### Training, development & rotations

You'll be paired with senior team members from week one and work directly on live problems rather than sandboxed exercises. Because AICines spans streaming, social product, AI generation, and film production, there's genuine scope to explore adjacent areas — infrastructure, data pipelines, or AI-adjacent backend work — based on where your interest develops.

### Salary & benefits

Compensation is benchmarked competitively for remote roles and varies by experience level. The role is fully remote with flexible working hours. You'll get hands-on exposure to production AI systems and a live platform with real users, plus direct access to founders and senior engineers.

### Career progression

AICines is scaling, and progression is based on impact rather than tenure. Strong performers move into specialised backend/infra tracks or broader technical leadership roles as the team grows. Interns who perform well are considered for full-time positions.

### Who we're looking for

- Currently studying or recently graduated in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
- Working knowledge of at least one backend language/framework (Node.js, Python, Java, or similar) and databases
- Comfortable working in a fast-moving, remote-first team
- Curious, self-directed, and able to communicate technical decisions clearly
- No prior professional experience required — students, recent graduates, and junior candidates are all encouraged to apply

### How to apply

Click apply and submit your resume along with any relevant projects, coursework, or portfolio work. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and shortlisted candidates are contacted within one week.

# Make an impact that matters and grow faster than you imagined

At Fortinet, your work helps secure the world, and your career accelerates through purpose, innovation, and opportunity

![careers mission](https://www.fortinet.com/content/dam/fortinet/images/general/careers-mission.png)

Our Mission

## What drives us

Founded in the San Francisco Bay Area in 2000, Fortinet continues to be a driving force in the evolution of cybersecurity and the convergence of networking and security. Securing people, devices, and data everywhere is our mission.

Our Values

## What we stand for

For more than 25 years, we’ve built a culture where driven people can do the best work of their career. We move fast, support one another, and take pride in solving meaningful problems. Our values guide how we work and how we grow together.

![icon openness](https://www.fortinet.com/content/dam/fortinet/images/icons/careers/icon-openness.svg)

### Openness

Sharing knowledge and information collaboratively and transparently, with respect to one’s thoughts and opinions

![icon teamwork](https://www.fortinet.com/content/dam/fortinet/images/icons/careers/icon-teamwork.svg)

### Teamwork

Working collaboratively to build high morale and group commitment for solving challenging and complex problems

![icon innovation](https://www.fortinet.com/content/dam/fortinet/images/icons/careers/icon-innovation.svg)

### Innovation

Developing original ideas and solutions and finding new and better ways to deliver excellence

Our Culture

## Life at Fortinet

Working at Fortinet is not just another job; it’s about making a difference. We help our customers secure their operations and enable them to support their users in a trusted and capable way. We take on some of the world’s toughest security challenges, and we do it together. Life at Fortinet means working in a culture of openness and innovation where everyone can contribute and grow.

![careers collage](https://www.fortinet.com/content/dam/fortinet/images/general/careers-collage.png)

Our teams

## Find your place

Fortinet combines the scale of a global cybersecurity leader with the agility of a fast-growing innovator. Our teams move quickly, take ownership, and build solutions that protect millions of customers worldwide. If you’re driven by impact and energized by growth, you’ll thrive here.

### Marketing

Be part of a creative team in corporate, field, or product marketing.

![](https://www.fortinet.com/content/dam/fortinet/images/icons/careers/icon-operations.svg)

### Operations

Manage the build of incredible products that keep people safe.

![](https://www.fortinet.com/content/dam/fortinet/images/icons/careers/icon-finance.svg)

### Finance

Contribute to the evolution of our financial strategy.

We invest in you

## Benefits and Perks

Working at Fortinet means doing meaningful work with people who care and being supported with a competitive Total Rewards package that helps you thrive. We offer comprehensive benefits that support your health, your financial well-being, and the moments in life that matter most.

![](https://www.fortinet.com/content/dam/fortinet/images/icons/careers/icon-compensation.svg)

Competitive salary and incentive compensation, stock awards, health and welfare benefits

![](https://www.fortinet.com/content/dam/fortinet/images/icons/careers/icon-performance-increase.svg)

Global retirement and savings programs; specifics vary by region

As an AI Engineer at AICines, you'll build the generation pipelines behind a live production platform — video and image models, prompt systems, character consistency, and the infrastructure that makes it all run at scale. This is production AI work, not notebooks.

### Day to day, you'll:

- Build and maintain AI video and image generation pipelines
- Integrate and evaluate models — video, image, audio, and LLMs
- Build prompt systems for consistent characters, styles, and worlds across generations
- Optimise inference cost and latency for a live, global user base
- Build internal tooling for the creative team
- Test new models as they release and report what's worth adopting

### Training, development & rotations

You'll be paired with senior team members from week one and work directly on live problems rather than sandboxed exercises. Because AICines spans streaming, social product, AI generation, and film production, there's genuine scope to explore adjacent areas — inference infrastructure, prompt engineering, or product-facing ML work — based on where your interest develops.

### Salary & benefits

Compensation is benchmarked competitively for remote roles and varies by experience level. The role is fully remote with flexible working hours. You'll get hands-on exposure to production AI systems and a live platform with real users, plus direct access to founders and senior engineers.

### Career progression

AICines is scaling, and progression is based on impact rather than tenure. Strong performers move into specialised ML tracks or broader engineering roles as the team grows. Interns who perform well are considered for full-time positions.

### Who we're looking for

- Currently studying or recently graduated, any technical field (Computer Science, AI/ML, Engineering, or similar)
- Python — the core requirement
- Hands-on with any of: LLM APIs, diffusion models, video generation, or ML frameworks
- Understanding of APIs, async work, and cloud basics
- A GitHub, published project, or body of generated work
- No prior professional experience required — students, recent graduates, and junior candidates are all encouraged to apply

## An Out of the Ordinary career move

![Image of a zebra](https://www.investec.com/cdn-cgi/image/q=80,f=auto,fit=scale-down,onerror=redirect,metadata=none,w=575/etc.clientlibs/dotcom/clientlibs/dotcom/common/head/resources/images/zebras/default/default-zebra-1.png)

Ready to challenge the conventional?


At Investec, we are more about creating paths than following them. We strive to live Out of the Ordinary. The same can be said about our people. We look for qualities that cannot be captured on paper; the things that make you unique.

Entrepreneurs are always welcome

### Looking to partner with Out of the Ordinary?

Energy, passion and outstanding talent are what drive us. If this drives you, view our opportunities and connect with us.

# Software Engineer (Python)

South Africa

Apply Now

**Takealot.com**, South Africa’s leading online retailer, is looking for a highly talented **Senior Software Engineer (Python)** to join our team. We are a young, dynamic, hyper-growth company looking for smart, creative, hard-working people with integrity to join us!

**Think you’ve been challenged before? Think again!**

- **Scale**: Over 4 million happy shoppers shop online on takealot.com. Show them what you can do.
- **Learn**: We work with the best of the best. Code alongside industry leaders and up-skill in record time.
- **Grow**: Expand your career in the fast-growing Takealot Group: takealot.com, and Mr D. We like to promote from within: Here’s your chance.

**Who’s who in the tech space**

This position reports to the respective team's manager.

**Your mission, should you choose to accept it:**

As a Software Engineer, you will be someone whose expertise directly translates into developing robust software in the e-commerce domain. You will have the opportunity to implement best practices to improve existing software and participate in the development of new features. While we don't promote after-hours work as part of the regular workday, we run a 24/7 business with the need to keep systems up and running. Software Engineers are expected to provide after-hours support on a rotational basis to resolve critical system issues if needed.

- Design and build solutions to assist our business users and improve customer experience
- Architect and design solutions with your team
- Develop code, making major improvements to non-functional areas
- Develop high-quality production code for work of high complexity and scale
- Utilize and improve functional and non-functional testing practices
- Champion, challenge, and iterate on best practices within engineering
- Design solutions for complex problems with difficult decision trade-offs, typically system or domain-wide
- Participate in and collaborate on architecture proposals across engineering
- Support alignment of architecture across the organisation
- Respond to and resolve bugs in production for systems in your division
- Respond to alerts and support incident response within your division
- Investigate and drive the resolution of issues that impact multiple teams
- Support, challenge existing, and define new engineering processes and directives
- Review and contribute fixes and content to internal documentation
- React to technology trends, identifying risks and opportunities for your division's technologies, systems, and domains
- Share knowledge through blog posts, tech talks, and workshops across engineering
- Contribute to discussions and decisions in the division
- Challenge others to always produce work of the highest quality
- REST and RPC API implementation and maintenance (using Python)
- Develop and maintain automation tests
- Liaise with various internal stakeholders to discuss project requirements, progress, etc.

**The skills we need:**

- Solutions-oriented, can-do attitude, and high energy
- Strong analytical and critical thinking, using data to inform decisions
- Ability to disaggregate and structure solutions to ambiguous problems
- Solid quantitative skills
- Capability to present ideas succinctly, in writing and verbally
- Versatile and with the appetite to learn by doing

**Qualifications & Experience:**

- Bachelor’s degree or an Advanced Diploma in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
- 3 to 6 years in a software development role for a mid-level role
- 5 to 10 years in a software development role for a senior role
- A thorough understanding of computer science fundamentals, including object-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms
- Experience in writing robust, efficient production code
- Proficient in a strongly typed open source language such as Python, Java, Golang, etc
- Exposure to RESTful APIs and web services.
- Experience with SQL database systems
- Experience with development in a Linux environment

Experience in the following will be advantageous:

- Familiarity with microservices architecture
- Experience working in an Agile environment
- MySQL, PostgreSQL, MS SQL
- Memcached, Redis
- Message Brokers, Queues, and PubSub systems (e.g., Kafka and RabbitMQ)
- Containerisation (e.g., Docker)
- Orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes)
- GitHub, Travis CI, Jenkins
- AWS, GCP, Azure
- JavaScript, React, jQuery

**Let’s talk about life @ Takealot Group**

- **The power is in your hands**: We offer a market-related Total Remuneration Package that allows full flexibility according to your needs. Go on, be the master of your own destiny.
- **No doors**: We aren’t fans of stuffy offices or siloed work environments. See someone you like, high-five, collab, and make something great.
- **Remote working**: Enjoy the flexibility of working from home while having the option for in-office interactions. Takealot.com provides a fully remote setup with the choice to visit the office to relish in those water cooler moments when desired.
- **Mentorship programme**: We aren’t kidding when we say the people with the best people win. Now’s your chance to be one of the best by learning from the best.
- **Naspers Tech Community** **& Online Learning**: Share ideas and grow with global industry leaders who are all just a Slack message away. Love to learn? Up-skill with free access to courses on MyAcademy, Udacity, Coursera, and more.
- **Good times**: Get to know the other extraordinary minds at takealot.com during regular social events and out-of-office activities (think hikes, think mini golf, think good times).
- **Staff discount:** Takealotmore subscriptions and millions of products across 28 departments. What more could you ask for?
- **Birthday leave**: Cake Day all the way. Enjoy your day off - you deserve it.
- **Right tools, right job**: Mac or Linux, two monitors or one. Whatever your preference, you’ll work on the latest tech, off the latest tech.
- **Help when you need it most**: Confidential counselling, legal support, and financial guidance, anytime, anywhere.
- **Tech stack (for days):** ReactJS, Python, Scala, Kotlin, Swift, Google Cloud, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, and all things machine learning. If you build it, they will come.
- **Free parking:** No more 5km fun runs to your desk (unless you want to).

**Like what you see?**

If you meet the above, you are an **Extraordinary Mind.** Apply today!!

# Senior Machine Learning Engineer

Mr D

South Africa

Salary not specified \- Full-time

Apply externally

## Job Description

### About the Role

Mr D,

### Requirements

- Degree in Computer Science or Engineering (alternatively, a degree in a related field with work experience as a software engineer).
- 5 to 10+ years of experience applying machine learning to real-world problems OR
- 5 to 10+ years of commercial software development experience
- Strong understanding of statistical analysis, modeling, and machine learning techniques.
- Experience working within an agile team that is operationally hands-on and an advocate of that culture.
- Experience with Python
- Experience with Linux
- Experience with BigQuery.
- Experience with TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, PyTorch, and Pandas.
- Experience building scalable data processing pipelines for machine learning workflows.
- Experience with deploying machine learning to production environments.
- Data Mining and Big Data experience.
- MSc (master of science) or PhD (doctorate).
- Experience with cloud-based platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Amazon Web Services (AWS).
- Experience with end-to-end machine learning frameworks such as Kubeflow, TensorFlow Extended, MLflow, Sagemaker Pipelines or GCP VertexAI/Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Pipelines.
- Experience with serving machine learning models, such as TensorFlow Serving, KServe, or managed serving solutions such as AWS Sagemaker Endpoints and GCP VertexAI/ Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Endpoints.
- Experience designing and executing large-scale LLM prompt pipelines for automated tasks such as classification and data extraction.

WHY JOIN **03**

## Work on systems that matter,  with a team that ships.Work on systems that matter,  with a team that ships.

Real work, real systems, real customers. We build platforms running
_1,000+ sites_, multi-channel order management, international device
repair, same-day delivery logistics. Not side projects. Not demos. Live operations.


·STACK

### C\#, .NET, SQL Server on Azure

Our production stack. CloudCore is .NET throughout. Azure-native: App Services, SQL, Functions, Blob Storage. Provider-agnostic AI integration via the workflow engine; Google Gemini in production today inside our exam-paper management system.

·METHOD

### Agile, iterative, shipping in weeks

Sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews with clients, retros. Real software demos, not slides. See [how we develop](https://www.exclr8.co.za/howwedevelop.php).

·GROWTH

### Complex systems, close mentorship

Juniors work alongside seniors on production systems from day one. You learn the stack, the methodology and the business domain in parallel, and grow into complex systems work fast.

More on what it's like to work here: [Why Join Exclr8](https://www.exclr8.co.za/whyjointeam.php).


FAQ **04**

## Common questions about  working here.Common questions about  working here.

What roles are open?

Senior Software Engineer, Junior Software Engineer, QA Test Engineer, Mobile App Developer, and a Sales and Marketing Representative. Each role has its own page with the detail.

Where is the job based?

Cape Town, hybrid. Our clients are across South Africa, Ireland and the United Kingdom, so the systems you work on run in three countries even though the team is here.

What is the technology stack?

C#, .NET and SQL Server on Microsoft Azure. CloudCore is .NET throughout and Azure-native: App Services, SQL, Functions and Blob Storage, with provider-agnostic AI integration through the workflow engine.

What would I actually be working on?

Live operations, not side projects and not demos. Platforms running more than 1,000 sites, multi-channel order management, international device repair and same-day delivery logistics.

Can I apply if I am early in my career?

Yes. The Junior Software Engineer role is built for it: you learn the stack, the methodology and the business domain in parallel alongside senior engineers on real production systems, and grow into complex systems work fast.

How does the team actually work?

Short sprints with stand-ups, sprint reviews with clients and retrospectives. Reviews demo real software rather than slides, and every release moves through development, test, UAT and live before it touches real operations.

How do I apply?

Open the role that fits and get in touch through the contact page. If none of the listed roles is quite right but the work is, say so anyway and tell us what you would want to be doing.

## Description

TransLution builds shop floor and warehouse execution software that integrates deeply with ERP Systems. Our solutions run in live production environments for 350+ manufacturing customers.

When our code works, operations run. When it doesn’t, forklifts stop and production lines wait. That’s the job.

**THE ROLE**

We’re hiring a Software Engineer who can translate business requirements into working systems — specifically, the data logic and automation that sits between an ERP and the physical operation of a warehouse or factory floor.

Most of your time will be spent in Microsoft SQL Server. We need someone who is genuinely strong here — writing stored procedures, designing for performance, and structuring data that gets hit hard in real-time environments. This isn’t reporting work. It’s transactional, operational, and it has to be fast.

Beyond SQL, you’ll take on custom projects and R&D work. When the standard toolset doesn’t solve the problem, you build what’s needed — sometimes in VB, sometimes in other scripting tools, sometimes in something new entirely. We care more about solving the problem well than about which language you use.

You’ll own your solutions end to end: from reading the Business Requirement Specification, through designing the logic, to peer-testing it and supporting the go-live. On-site travel is minimal and varies by project, but when a client is going live, you’re the person they rely on technically.

**WHAT WE EXPECT**

- Deep T-SQL capability. Complex stored procedures, query optimisation, database design for high-throughput environments. This is non-negotiable.

- Logical rigour. You test your own work like someone who knows what happens when bad data hits a shop floor at 6am on a Monday.

- Comfort with ambiguity. Client operations are messy. Requirements shift. You need to figure out what the system actually needs to do, not just what the spec says.

- Willingness to work with legacy tools. We use VB in places. It’s not glamorous, but it works and it needs to be maintained and extended.

- Curiosity about new approaches. We’re actively investing in R&D. If you want to research and build, there’s space for that here.

**WHO TENDS TO DO WELL HERE**

People with engineering backgrounds (mechanical, electrical, chemical) often do well because they think in systems and understand physical operations. So do computer science graduates who care about why something works, not just that it works. We’ve found that the common thread is strong logical reasoning and a genuine interest in how data drives real-world outcomes.

If you’ve worked with ERP systems like SYSPRO or SAP, that’s useful context — but we’d rather hire someone who learns fast than someone who already knows the domain.

## Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline

- 3+ years in a technical role involving software implementation, systems integration, or data engineering

- Advanced Microsoft SQL Server / T-SQL skills (mandatory)

- Exposure to VB.NET, Python, or similar scripting languages (beneficial)

- Experience with ERP systems is an advantage, not a requirement

## Benefits

Company contributions include provident fund, group-life insurance and funeral plan.

# Software Engineer

Full time

# **SOFWARE ENGINEER**

Check out The Global Talent Co.’s talent network: [https://www.globaltalent.co/network](https://www.globaltalent.co/network)

## **The Role**

You will join a company building the **digital infrastructure for grant funding**, helping organizations spend less time navigating funding logic, forms, and administration and more time on the projects and impact that matter.

The platform brings together **research across 18,000+ funding programmes, AI-supported analysis and application drafting, expert review, and ongoing grant management**. AI handles what can scale, while people bring experience and judgement where it matters.

As a **Software Engineer**, you will help build the product across the **backend, frontend, and AI pipeline** at the core of the platform. You will work directly with the **CTO**, who already has one successful exit, and learn first-hand how modern software is built in a clean, fast, AI-native environment.

This role is designed for someone **early in their career who wants real responsibility and a steep learning curve**. You will start with close guidance and progressively take on more independent ownership, with a clear path toward a senior engineering role.

## **Position: Software Engineer**

Seeking an early-career **Software Engineer** with solid programming fundamentals, curiosity across the stack, and a strong desire to learn how production software is built.

The ideal candidate has **1–3 years of experience or is a recent graduate with strong projects**, and combines technical curiosity with high self-motivation, a user-first mindset, and an AI-native approach to development.

What you have built matters more than simply the number of years on your CV.

# **Responsibilities**

### **Product Development & Full-Stack Engineering**

- Ship **features end-to-end**, from backend development through to the user interface.

- Work across the stack, including **React, Node/Express, Postgres, and AWS**.

- Start with close guidance and progressively take on **greater independence and ownership**.

- Work closely with the **CTO and grant team** to build solutions based on real user problems rather than abstract tickets.

- Build software with a **user-first mindset**, ensuring what you create works for real people.


### **AI Development**

- Help build the platform's **AI pipeline from week one**.

- Work with **prompt engineering, context management, and AI evaluations**.

- Gain hands-on experience with AI development and learn how AI-powered features are built and improved in production.

- Use **AI-native development tools such as Claude Code or Cursor** as part of your engineering workflow.


### **Production & Debugging**

- Trace and fix bugs in the **production environment**.

- Work with tools including **Sentry, CloudWatch, and Postgres**.

- Learn how production systems work by investigating real issues and understanding their underlying causes.

- Develop strong debugging and problem-solving skills through hands-on production experience.


### **Learning & Engineering Growth**

- Work closely with the **CTO** and receive direct technical mentoring.

- Use **code reviews as a learning tool**, incorporating feedback and progressively contributing feedback to others.

- Take increasing ownership of features and technical problems as your experience grows.

- Develop toward **independent feature ownership**, with a clear path toward a senior engineering role.

- Contribute to improving the time from starting a project to a **finished, submitted application** through reliable features, automation, and product improvements.


# **Requirements**

- **1–3 years of professional experience as a Software Engineer**, or recent university graduation with strong technical projects.

- What you have **built** matters more than simply the number of years of experience.

- Solid fundamentals in **TypeScript and/or JavaScript**.

- Curiosity and willingness to work across the full stack, including:

  - **React**

  - **Node / Express**

  - **Postgres**

  - **AWS**
- Strong desire to learn how **production software is built and operated**.

- High self-motivation and the ability to **dig into problems rather than wait for instructions**.

- Comfortable receiving feedback and using it to improve your technical skills.

- **AI-native approach to software development**, with familiarity using tools such as **Claude Code or Cursor**.

- **User-first mindset**, with a focus on building software that works for real people.

- Strong curiosity, ownership, and willingness to take on increasing responsibility.


# **Nice to Have**

- First experience with **AI tools or LLM APIs**, including university or side projects.

- **German language skills at B1 level or above**. The product and customers are German-speaking, while the team works bilingually.

- A **side project, open-source contribution, or other work built independently**.


# **Growth Path**

This role is designed as a **springboard for your engineering career**.

You will start with significant mentoring and guidance from the CTO, then progressively move toward independent ownership of complete features and technical problems.

The goal is that, over time, you can **ship independently, contribute to technical decisions, and take ownership of increasingly complex parts of the product**, with a clear path toward a senior engineering role.

# **What We Offer**

- **Direct mentoring from the CTO**, who already has one successful exit and will work closely with you on your development.

- A **steep learning curve** across a modern technology stack, AI-native development, and real production systems.

- **Real production ownership from day one**, with increasing responsibility over time.

- **Fully remote work** is possible.

- **Competitive entry-level salary** and participation in company success.

- **Clear development path toward a senior engineering role**.

- **€2,000 annual professional development budget**.

- Opportunity to work on a **scalable SaaS product** with clear market demand and genuine social impact.

- **Short decision paths** and direct collaboration with the leadership team.

- **Team events and optional workations**.

### Job summary

Teraco – A Digital Realty Company is looking for a Graduate Data Scientist to enhance its data and analytics capabilities. The role involves designing data pipelines, deploying AI models, and delivering actionable insights through data visualisations.

The ideal candidate has a degree in Data Science and experience in data engineering and machine learning, along with strong problem-solving and communication skills. Join us in Gauteng, South Africa, for this exciting opportunity.

### Qualifications

- Experience with data, analysis and machine learning models.
- Experience with coding using Python or similar.
- Experience with database querying using SQL.

### Responsibilities

- Design and build data pipelines.
- Deliver actionable insights from data.
- Build and deploy AI models.
- Incorporate best practices of managing big data.

### Skills

Excellent communication skills

Problem-solving mindset

Ability to understand and simplify the complex

Capability to work independently and as part of a team

Self-motivated and professional

# Junior Software Developer Jobs in South Africa

Writes, tests and maintains code as part of a development team. South Africa has a severe shortage of developers, so junior and graduate developers — including self-taught and bootcamp grads — are in high demand across Durban, Umhlanga and the whole country.

Also known as: Junior DeveloperAlso known as: Graduate DeveloperAlso known as: Software Engineer (Junior)Also known as: ProgrammerAlso known as: Full-Stack Developer (Junior)

## Salary Guide

Entry Level

R15,000–R25,000/month

0–1 year experience

Mid Level

R25,000–R45,000/month

2–4 years experience

Senior Level

R45,000–R70,000/month

5+ years experience

## Requirements

### Essential

- Coding ability in at least one language (JavaScript, Python, Java, C#)
- Understanding of version control (Git)
- Problem-solving and logic
- A diploma/degree OR a strong portfolio
- Willingness to keep learning

### Nice to Have

- Computer Science / IT qualification
- Public GitHub portfolio
- Framework experience (React, .NET, Spring, Django)
- Basic SQL
- Agile/Scrum exposure

## A Typical Day

1

Build features from tickets/user stories

2

Fix bugs and write tests

3

Review code with senior developers

4

Attend stand-ups and sprint planning

5

Read documentation and learn new tools

**Work Environment:** Office or fully remote. Collaborative, project-based, tools like Git, Jira and Slack. One of the most remote-friendly careers in SA — many juniors work for Cape Town, Joburg or overseas companies from KZN.

**Shift Patterns:** Standard business hours, flexible/remote common. Occasional crunch near releases.

## Career Progression

1

### Junior Developer

0–2 years

R15,000–R25,000/month

2

### Intermediate Developer

2–4 years

R30,000–R55,000/month

3

### Senior Developer

4–7 years

R55,000–R90,000/month

4

### Tech Lead / Solutions Architect

7–10 years

R90,000–R140,000+/month

## Interview Preparation

### Top Interview Tips

- 1Bring a portfolio or GitHub — even personal projects count
- 2Be ready for a live coding or take-home task
- 3Explain your thinking out loud, not just the answer
- 4Know the basics of the language on your CV deeply
- 5Show curiosity and a learning habit

### Common Assessments

Live coding / pair-programming taskTake-home projectLogic and problem-solving testTechnical Q&A on your stackCulture-fit interview

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What qualifications do I need to become a Junior Software Developer?

Coding ability in at least one language (JavaScript, Python, Java, C#). Understanding of version control (Git). Problem-solving and logic. A diploma/degree OR a strong portfolio. Willingness to keep learning.

### How much does a Junior Software Developer earn in South Africa?

Entry level: R15,000–R25,000/month. Mid-level: R25,000–R45,000/month. Senior: R45,000–R70,000/month.

### What is a typical day like for a Junior Software Developer?

Build features from tickets/user stories. Fix bugs and write tests. Review code with senior developers. Attend stand-ups and sprint planning. Read documentation and learn new tools.

### What shifts do Junior Software Developers work?

Standard business hours, flexible/remote common. Occasional crunch near releases.

### How do I prepare for a Junior Software Developer interview?

Bring a portfolio or GitHub — even personal projects count. Be ready for a live coding or take-home task. Explain your thinking out loud, not just the answer. Know the basics of the language on your CV deeply. Show curiosity and a learning habit.

## Full Stack Software Engineer - Cape Town

Cape Town

Theodo UK – Software Engineering /

Hybrid

[apply for this job](https://jobs.lever.co/theodo/31633ba7-be82-4389-9eec-f045bf258bf8/apply)

**Role Mission**

We’re building a team of highly-skilled engineers who want one thing above all else: to write excellent code, every day, and continuously level up technically.

You're the kind of person who thrives on solving hard technical problems, learning from brilliant peers, and getting deep into the codebase — day in, day out.

This isn’t solo hacker mode. You’ll be part of a high-performing team and expected to navigate real-world, fast-moving client projects. That means collaborating thoughtfully, communicating clearly, and being proactive in unblocking yourself and others. We want engineers who ask great questions, learn from their teammates, and know how to get what they need to do their best work.

**Skills**

\\* Experience with C# and .NET

\\* Frontend development experience with React

\* Proficiency with cloud platforms (preferably AWS, within a serverless architecture)

\\* Proven ability to manage external clients and build strong working relationships

\\* Demonstrated skill in managing stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams

\\* STEM or Computer Science degree, or equivalent practical experience

\\* 3 years of hands-on experience in a Full Stack Engineering

**What we Offer**

Alongside a competitive salary, we also offer:

\\* 22 Days annual leave

\\* Learning and Development Support throughout your career at Theodo

\\* 3 week work from anywhere policy

\\* Equipment budget for your tech set up

\\* Company pension

\\* Monthly Socials

\\* A Slack network of 600+ engineers across our extended ecosystem — ask questions, share patterns, or troubleshoot obscure bugs with some of the sharpest devs out there.

\\* Monthly "Lunch & Tells" — in-person sessions to share technical discoveries, cool code tricks, or war stories from the field with fellow engineers.

You'll work on a hybrid basis from our office based in Green Point, Cape Town—a vibrant location, with amenities, beaches, parks, and the CBD all within close proximity.

**Who are we**

Theodo UK is a software consultancy specialising in full-stack development, mobile and web applications and cloud solutions.   We are a 70-person team based in the **UK and South Africa**, and we’re growing quickly. **Theodo UK** operates with the entrepreneurial drive, agility and ownership mindset of a start-up, but with the financial stability, global reputation and technical depth of the wider Theodo Group behind [us.This](http://us.this/) unique position allows our team to innovate quickly, take smart risks, and build real value for clients—without compromising on quality. We follow Lean and Kaizen principles to continuously improve and deliver high-quality digital products at speed.

While headquartered in the UK, our reach is global. Supported by our South African team, we manage projects across English-speaking markets worldwide.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What kinds of Web and Mobile roles are listed on this page?

This page includes a variety of roles: from front‑end web developers (JavaScript, Angular, Vue, etc.), full‑stack web developers, to native or hybrid mobile developers (iOS, Android, cross‑platform, mobile‑web). Roles may be permanent or contract, junior to senior, and cover a range of industries.

Are Web & Mobile jobs only available in Johannesburg, or do you have roles in Cape Town and remote‑friendly positions?

While many job listings are based in Gauteng / Johannesburg, there are also roles listed for Cape Town and remote or hybrid-remote positions, and you’re welcome to apply from anywhere in South Africa.

Can I apply if I prefer fully remote or hybrid work for Web/Mobile roles?

Yes, several of the roles are marked “fully remote,” “semi‑remote,” or “hybrid”, depending on client needs. If you prefer remote or hybrid work, mention this when you submit your CV so we can match you accordingly.

How do I apply or submit my CV for a Web or Mobile role?

To apply, simply click the “Submit CV” button at the top of the Web & Mobile jobs page (or use “Refer a Friend” if relevant). Include your relevant skills (web frameworks, mobile platforms, preferred work type, location or remote‑preference), and our recruiters will match your profile to suitable vacancies.

What skills and experience are typically required for Web & Mobile roles?

Depending on the role: for web roles, HTML/CSS, JavaScript and frameworks such as Angular, Vue or React, API integration and responsive design; for mobile roles, experience with iOS/Android or cross‑platform frameworks, mobile UI/UX, and possibly web‑to‑mobile integration skills. Familiarity with web security, API usage, and responsive/mobile‑first development is often advantageous.

What can I expect after submitting my CV — what’s the hiring process and typical response time?

Once you submit your CV, our recruitment team reviews the profile. If there’s a match with a live Web or Mobile role, you’ll usually be contacted within a few working days to discuss details and next steps (interview, screening or role‑matching).

## About the position

Our client is looking for a senior DevOps / SRE Cloud Engineer to own the company’s Azure-based Kubernetes platform end-to-end — resilient infrastructure, hardened CI/CD, and strong observability so the company’s workloads run reliably at scale.

**Key roles & responsibilities:**

- Operate production Kubernetes clusters and Azure infrastructure as Terraform code.
- Maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) with quality gates for reliable deployments.
- Own observability: dashboards, alerting, SLOs, and incident response.
- Manage secrets, identity, and network security across environments.
- Partners with engineering teams to troubleshoot and improve reliability.

**Must-have technical skills / experience:**

- Azure cloud platform — production experience with AKS, ADLS Gen2 (blob storage), Azure Key Vault, Entra ID (incl. workload identity / managed identities), Azure networking (VNets, private endpoints, firewall rules), and Azure Service Bus or an equivalent message broker.
- Kubernetes in production — deploying and operating self-managed (non-PaaS) workloads: Helm chart authoring, environment overlays, K8s operators, node-pool design, resource requests/limits and capacity sizing, pod troubleshooting, upgrades.
- Terraform — authoring and maintaining modular IaC for cluster, identity, storage, and secrets provisioning; state management and plan/apply discipline across environments.
- Docker — image builds (multi-arch), Compose-based local development stacks, container health checks and memory-limit tuning.
- CI/CD with GitHub Actions — building and maintaining pipelines for lint/test/build gates and container image publishing; branch-protection / required-status-check workflows.
- Observability and SRE practice — Prometheus + Grafana (dashboards, alert rules), SLO/alerting design, incident response, capacity planning from measured load; structured logging.
- Linux and shell scripting — strong Bash; comfortable owning operational scripts as maintained, tested code.
- Secrets management — provider-chain patterns (Key Vault in prod, env/file locally); keeping secrets out of repos and images.

**Preferred / nice-to-have technical skills:**

- Apache Spark on Kubernetes operations — Spark Operator, cluster sizing, executor/driver tuning, Spark Connect; Jupyter Hub on K8s.
- Open data-platform stack — Hive Metastore, Trino, Apache Ranger, Delta Lake, S3-compatible object storage (MinIO); understanding of how governed query surfaces are wired.
- Open Telemetry — SDK-based metrics/traces instrumentation and collector topology; Open Lineage/Marquez lineage.
- Python — enough to maintain operational tooling and pytest-based environment/infrastructure test tiers.
- SQL Server and PostgreSQL — operational administration (backups, container deployments, EF-migration-driven schemas).
- Multi-tenant / regulated-data environments — tenant isolation patterns, POPIA/GDPR/ISO 27001-adjacent controls; secret scanning and supply-chain hygiene (dependency audit, image provenance).

**Seniority and experience:**

- Senior (mid-senior acceptable with strong K8s depth). 5+ years DevOps/SRE/platform engineering, including 2–3 years running Kubernetes workloads in production and 2+ years on Azure. Must be able to own the environment independently.

**Required qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
- Cloud/Kubernetes certification (e.g. Azure, CKA) advantageous.
- Proven experience operating production-grade cloud infrastructure at scale; strong communication skills and ability to work independently in a hybrid/remote team.

**Why you’ll love working for the company:**

The company believes in taking care of their team and creating an environment where you can thrive. As part of their company, you’ll enjoy:

- **Flexible working arrangements**: Whether you’re a night owl or an early bird, they offer hybrid and remote options to suit your lifestyle
- **Comprehensive benefits**: From a wellness program to home office reimbursements and continuous learning opportunities, they have got you covered.
- **Team culture**: Fun team-building activities, regular socials, and a supportive, inclusive culture that values transparency, accountability, and work-life balance.
- **Performance incentives**: Competitive salaries, ESOP, and recognition for your hard work.

# Junior–Mid Frontend Developer Full Time

[![](https://i0.wp.com/hireresolve.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/cropped-SQHR-Logo.png?fit=300%2C300&ssl=1)](https://hireresolve.co.za/company/hire-resolve/)

#### [**Hire Resolve – Top Recruitment Agency**](https://hireresolve.co.za/company/hire-resolve/)   Ticking All Your Recruitment Needs

[Website](https://www.linkedin.com/company/hire-resolve/mycompany/)[Careers@hireresolve.za.com](mailto:Careers@hireresolve.za.com)[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/HireResolve)[+27 0 21 551 8638](tel:+27 0 21 551 8638)

[Apply for job](https://hireresolve.simplify.hr/vacancy/s4phcc)

A South African-based company that provides **data-driven energy efficiency, monitoring, and renewable energy solutions** for businesses and industries is seeking a **Frontend-heavy Developer** to join their lean, fast-moving energy monitoring team. You will build and maintain responsive web interfaces and data-rich dashboards, with the opportunity to expand into backend development as you grow.

**Responsibilities:**

- **UI/UX Development:** Build and maintain responsive web interfaces using HTML, CSS, and Modern JS.

- **Data Visualization:** Develop interactive dashboards for real-time energy monitoring.

- **Integration:** Connect frontends with REST APIs and real-time streams (MQTT/WebSockets).

- **Collaboration:** Work with the Tech Lead to design features and conduct code reviews.

- **Full Stack Growth:** Contribute to light backend tasks, including API endpoints and server-side logic.

- **Problem Solving:** Troubleshoot integration issues across diverse client deployments.


**Minimum Requirements:**

- **Tenure:** 1–3 years of web development experience (including internships and freelancing).

- **Evidence:** A portfolio or GitHub with real-world examples (prioritized over formal qualifications).

- **Education:** Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent self-taught background.

- **Web Fundamentals:** Solid HTML5 and CSS3 skills (DOM, layouts, and responsive design).

- **JavaScript:** Proficiency in vanilla JS (ES6+) without framework dependency.

- **Data Handling:** Comfortable consuming REST APIs and working with JSON data.

- **Tools:** Basic understanding of version control using Git.

- **Problem Solving:** Ability to debug and troubleshoot frontend issues independently.


**Benefits:**

- Competitive salary based on experience (salary can potentially be more based on experience/skills)

**IF you meet the above requirements and want to make a career-changing move, apply today by emailing your CV to itcareers@hireresolve.za.com**

Kick-start your career in software development!

We are looking for an enthusiastic **Front-End Software Developer Intern** who is eager to gain practical, hands-on experience in a real business environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate or junior developer who has learned the fundamentals of front-end development and now wants the opportunity to **build, test and improve real-world applications**.

You don't need years of experience — we're looking for someone with a good foundation, a problem-solving mindset and a genuine interest in technology.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Working alongside the team, you will:

- Assist with developing and maintaining web-based applications and user interfaces.
- Build responsive, user-friendly front-end components.
- Assist with improving the usability and functionality of existing applications.
- Write clean, structured and maintainable code.
- Test applications and identify bugs or usability issues.
- Troubleshoot and assist with resolving technical problems.
- Work with developers and internal users to understand business requirements.
- Assist with implementing new features and system improvements.
- Participate in testing, documentation and deployment processes.
- Learn and apply software development best practices.
- Gain exposure to the full software development lifecycle.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You should have completed, or be completing, a relevant qualification in:

- Software Development
- Computer Science
- Information Technology
- Web Development
- Software Engineering

or a similar field.

You should have a basic working knowledge of:

- **HTML**
- **CSS**
- **JavaScript**
- Responsive web design
- Basic programming principles
- Version control such as **Git/GitHub**

Exposure to a modern front-end framework such as **Python, and Fast api.** would be advantageous, but is not essential.

YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:

- Love technology and enjoy figuring out how things work.
- Enjoy solving problems.
- Have strong attention to detail.
- Are willing to learn and take feedback.
- Can work independently but aren't afraid to ask questions.
- Take ownership of your work.
- Are curious and enjoy learning new technologies.
- Care about creating a good experience for the person using the software.

WHAT YOU'LL GAIN

This isn't an internship where you'll spend your time watching other people work.

You'll have the opportunity to gain practical experience in:

- Front-end application development
- UI development
- Testing and debugging
- Git and version control
- Working with live business systems
- Translating business requirements into technical solutions
- Working as part of a development team
- Software development processes and best practices

Most importantly, you'll have the opportunity to **build real things, solve real problems and develop practical experience that you can take into your software development career.**

# Search Software Engineer

South Africa

Apply Now

**Takealot.com**, South Africa’s leading online retailer, is looking for a highly talented **Software Engineer (backend, preferably with search experience)** to join our team. We are a young, dynamic, hyper-growth company looking for smart, creative, hard-working people with integrity to join us!

**Think you’ve been challenged before? Think again!**

- **Scale**: Over 4 million happy shoppers shop online on takealot.com. Show them what you can do.
- **Learn**: We work with the best of the best. Code alongside industry leaders and up-skill in record time.
- **Grow**: Expand your career in the fast-growing Takealot Group: takealot.com, TFS and Mr D. We like to promote from within: Here’s your chance.

**Who’s who in the tech space**

This position reports to the respective team's manager.

**Your mission, should you choose to accept it:**

As a Software Engineer, you will be someone whose expertise directly translates into developing robust software in the e-commerce domain. You will have the opportunity to implement best practices to improve existing software and participate in the development of new features. While we don't promote after-hours work as part of the regular workday, we run a 24/7 business with the need to keep systems up and running. Software Engineers are expected to provide after-hours support on a rotational basis to resolve critical system issues if needed.

The role is focused on maintaining our search stack. We are currently in the process of transitioning from Elasticsearch to Vertex AI Search, so experience with any of those would be a bonus, but not a necessity. Experience with any kind of search technology (Solr, Algolia) is relevant, but even if you don’t have search experience, the most important factor is that you enjoy building scalable back-end systems, and have a strong interest in understanding how search systems are built to scale to that serve millions of customers. Takealot runs mostly on Python, but experience in any of the mainstream backend languages (Python, Java or Go) is a plus.

- Design and build solutions to assist our business users and improve customer experience
- Architect and design solutions with your team
- Develop code, making major improvements to non-functional areas
- Develop high-quality production code for work of high complexity and scale
- Utilize and improve functional and non-functional testing practices
- Champion, challenge, and iterate on best practices within engineering
- Design solutions for complex problems with difficult decision trade-offs, typically system or domain-wide
- Participate in and collaborate on architecture proposals across engineering
- Support alignment of architecture across the organisation
- Respond to and resolve bugs in production for systems in your division
- Respond to alerts and support incident response within your division
- Investigate and drive the resolution of issues that impact multiple teams
- Support, challenge existing, and define new engineering processes and directives
- Review and contribute fixes and content to internal documentation
- React to technology trends, identifying risks and opportunities for your division's technologies, systems, and domains
- Share knowledge through blog posts, tech talks, and workshops across engineering
- Contribute to discussions and decisions in the division
- Challenge others to always produce work of the highest quality
- REST and RPC API implementation and maintenance (using Python)
- Develop and maintain automation tests
- Liaise with various internal stakeholders to discuss project requirements, progress, etc.

**The skills we need:**

- Solutions-oriented, can-do attitude, and high energy
- Strong analytical and critical thinking, using data to inform decisions
- Ability to dis-aggregate and structure solutions to ambiguous problems
- Solid quantitative skills
- Capability to present ideas succinctly, in writing and verbally
- Versatile and with the appetite to learn by doing

**Qualifications & Experience:**

- Bachelor’s degree or an Advanced Diploma in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
- 5 to 10 years in a software development role
- Developing scalable backend systems
- A thorough understanding of computer science fundamentals, including object-oriented design, data structures, and algorithms
- Writing robust, efficient production code
- Proficient in a strongly typed open source language such as Python, Java, Golang, etc
- RESTful APIs and web services.
- SQL database systems
- Development in a Linux environment

**Experience in the following will be advantageous:**

- Search technologies (Elasticsearch, Vertex AI Search, Solr, Algolia, or any other major third party provider)
- Familiarity with microservices architecture
- Working in an Agile environment
- MySQL, PostgreSQL
- Memcached, Redis
- Message Brokers, Queues, and PubSub systems (e.g., Kafka and RabbitMQ)
- Containerisation (e.g., Docker)
- Orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes)
- GitHub, Travis CI, Jenkins
- AWS, GCP, Azure
- JavaScript, React, jQuery

**Let’s talk about life @ Takealot Group**

- **The power is in your hands**: We offer a market-related Total Remuneration Package that allows full flexibility according to your needs. Go on, be the master of your own destiny.
- **No doors**: We aren’t fans of stuffy offices or siloed work environments. See someone you like, high-five, collab, and make something great.
- **Remote working**: Enjoy the flexibility of working from home while having the option for in-office interactions. Takealot.com provides a fully remote setup with the choice to visit the office to relish in those water cooler moments when desired.
- **Mentorship programme**: We aren’t kidding when we say the people with the best people win. Now’s your chance to be one of the best by learning from the best.
- **Naspers Tech Community** **& Online Learning**: Share ideas and grow with global industry leaders who are all just a Slack message away. Love to learn? Up-skill with free access to courses on MyAcademy, Udacity, Coursera, and more.
- **Good times**: Get to know the other extraordinary minds at takealot.com during regular social events and out-of-office activities (think hikes, think mini golf, think good times).
- **Staff discount:** Takealotmore subscriptions and millions of products across 28 departments. What more could you ask for?
- **Birthday leave**: Cake Day all the way. Enjoy your day off - you deserve it.
- **Right tools, right job**: Mac or Linux, two monitors or one. Whatever your preference, you’ll work on the latest tech, off the latest tech.
- **Help when you need it most**: Confidential counselling, legal support, and financial guidance, anytime, anywhere.
- **Tech stack (for days):** ReactJS, Python, Scala, Kotlin, Swift, Google Cloud, Kafka, Redis, Kubernetes, and all things machine learning. If you build it, they will come.
- **Free parking:** No more 5km fun runs to your desk (unless you want to).

**Like what you see?**

If you meet the above, you are an **Extraordinary Mind.** Apply today!!

_Takealot Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants from previously disadvantaged groups and people with disabilities will be given preference._
